Click'n'Load keeps every link, and a connection a host turns away no longer leaves its part of the file for later.

## ✨ Added

- **The bug report shows the speed.** The file from Settings, Health & diagnostics carries the speed of the last two minutes second by second and of the last hour in ten-second steps, and every running download with its backend and how many connections it has open. Names and links stay out.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Click'n'Load keeps part 1.** Some sites put sixteen bytes of noise in front of the first link, and KnightLoader dropped that link. A link now starts where its http:// begins.
- **Two Click'n'Load posts from one click both arrive.** A site that sends the first part on its own and the rest right after it lost the first part, because the second post replaced it in the browser extension. The extension joins them.
- **A refused connection's part is fetched right away.** When a host answered one connection too many with 403, nobody fetched that connection's part of the file until the rest was done. A free connection takes it over at once.
